name: Rehabiah
overview: Rehabiah is identified in Scripture as a prominent descendant of Eliezer, serving as the chief among his brothers and fathering a large number of sons. The genealogical records in 1 Chronicles highlight Rehabiah's role within the Levitical lineage, noting that from his line came Isshiah as a notable son. These passages emphasize Rehabiah's place in the established priestly families, underscoring God's providential ordering of His people through faithful generations.
